description: "Section 68 shall not apply" for the AMT (§ 56(b)(1)(E)): TY2026 the AMT allows the itemized deductions before the overall limitation. Single: wages $1,000,000, SALT paid $50,000 (allowed $10,000 after the phase-down), mortgage interest $30,000, cash gifts $100,000 (less the 0.5% floor $5,000). Itemized $135,000 before § 68; § 68 takes 2/37 × $135,000 = $7,297.30, leaving $127,702.70. AMTI = $1,000,000 − $127,702.70 + $10,000 (taxes) − $7,297.30 (§ 68) + ISO $1,000,000 = $1,875,000; exemption $0; TMT 28% × $1,875,000 − $4,890 = $520,110.
